$comment: Move manifest ai-credentials-v1 (ROUNDS-14-L02 stage A, #73): what pocketbase/pb_migrations/1700008820_ai_credentials_move.js does to each collection it touches. It runs once, at the first start of its release, in one transaction, after 1700008800 adds ai_credentials and ai_provider_models and 1700008810 makes ai_providers' client creates and updates server-only. It opens no key: PocketBase never holds AI_KEY_SECRET, and the runner rewraps each moved key as aad-v1 on its first good use (pocketbase/pb_hooks/ai_custody.js, convert). The dry run and the apply carry the same counts and checksum, and down() puts each moved pair and changed kind back (docs/operations.md, AI provider keys).

writes.encrypted_key, key_iv: cleared on a row whose whole pair moved; one half of a pair alone stays as it was
writes.kind: anthropic or openai with a base URL of its own becomes anthropic-compatible or openai-compatible

ai_providers.down: the moved pair back from ai_credentials.legacy_ciphertext and legacy_nonce on a row whose key columns are empty, and the changed kind back on a row that still has the kind it was given

ai_credentials.writes: one row a provider with a whole pair: wrap legacy-v0, key_version 1, the pair as ciphertext and nonce, a copy of it as legacy_ciphertext and legacy_nonce, no registered address, status active, or suspect-planted when the same pair sits under another account's provider

ai_provider_models.writes: one row a model: each model id in the provider's models_cache, registry for a first-party kind and user-declared for a compatible one, then each model an ai_settings row picks for it, user-declared, at most 1000 a provider; a cached entry that isn't a model id is skipped

journal.holds: {migration, kinds: [{provider, kind}]}, the kind of each provider the move changed, written only when it changed one
journal.down: read for the kinds, then removed

dry_run.report_path: required with the dry run, and refused inside pb_data; written 0600
dry_run.effect: takes the apply's path, writes the report, then throws, so PocketBase rolls the transaction back and nothing changes

report.checksum: sha256: over a chain, in provider id order, of each provider's id and what the move did with it (its key's status, whether its pair cleared, its new kind, its models), never a key

log_lines.apply: ai_credentials_moved, with the counts and the checksum
log_lines.dry_run: ai_credentials_move_dry_run, with the counts and the checksum
log_lines.failure: ai_credentials_move_failed, with the step that failed

rollback: migrate down 3 with this release's image, before the previous tag starts: this down step, then 1700008810's, then 1700008800's. A key entered after the upgrade has no older pair, so it is gone after the rollback and is entered again.
